finding.expected: Accept and authenticate the actually admitted immutable ACTIVE RUN head_sha=null shape while deriving and validating the candidate subject solely from separate canonical terminal RESULT/EVIDENCE and exact Git lineage. Reject inconsistent RUN/RESULT/head/subject contradictions, forged or incomplete source, and preserve all external trust-root, read-only, UNKNOWN fail-close and non-activation guards. Add focused tests matching an actual canonical RUN record and contradictory non-null/mismatched-head records; no broad suite or other production mutation.
finding.issue: The evaluator rejects genuine canonical ACTIVE RUN snapshots with head_sha null, because it requires run.head_sha equal to the candidate SHA even though canonical Runtime stores that exact candidate in terminal RESULT/EVIDENCE. Existing focused fixtures synthesize ACTIVE RUN with populated head_sha and therefore cannot detect the incompatible canonical form. This breaks authentic source provenance and applicability for real canonical RUN lineage against AC1/AC2 and omits a mandatory real-record-shape negative/positive case under AC6.
